selection.selection_rule: At least 3 evaluable samples including 2 high-effort confirmations; at least 2 substantive failures on a track, including one high-effort failure; explicit visual/evidence review by an identified reviewer (human or assistant).

selection_policy.rule: At least 3 evaluable samples including 2 high-effort confirmations; at least 2 substantive failures on a track, including one high-effort failure; explicit visual/evidence review by an identified reviewer (human or assistant).
selection_policy.clarification: The frozen initial task manifest used the phrase human review. Before inspecting any model output, this policy clarifies that recorded assistant visual/evidence review is acceptable. No prompts, references, numeric tolerances or failure-count thresholds changed.

selection.caveat: Astra-conditioned challenge set; cannot estimate general CAD success rates. Failures are conditional on the saved prompt/budget and unaided model. Physical-only failures do not establish inability to draw the shape.
